items.headline: Jefferson (ankle) ruled out vs. Dolphins
items.summary: Jefferson sprained his left ankle in Week 3 and didn't practice this week. Jordan Addison should be Minnesota's top target, with Jauan Jennings in the three-receiver sets. Kevin O'Connell hopes Jefferson returns in Week 5 at New Orleans.

items.headline: Eagles rule out DeVonta Smith (hamstring) vs. Rams
items.summary: With Smith and TE Dallas Goedert both out, Dontayvion Wicks steps in as the No. 1 receiver, and rookie Makai Lemon and Darius Cooper get bigger roles.

items.headline: Wicks becomes the Eagles' No. 1 receiver with Smith out
items.summary: Wicks scored 12+ fantasy points in each of his first two games, and his targets go deep (19.9 yards per catch, seven targets of 15+ air yards). The projection already gives him Smith's share of targets; this adds a little for the bigger role.

items.headline: Seahawks rule out rookie RB Price (chest) vs. Chargers
items.summary: Price aggravated a chest injury in Wednesday's practice and missed the rest of the week. Zach Charbonnet is also still out, so George Holani is next in line for carries.

items.headline: Texans get Collins (hamstring) back vs. Cowboys
items.summary: Collins practiced Wednesday and Thursday and returns after missing two games. Houston averaged 11.5 points without him and scored 31 in the one game he played.

items.headline: Nacua (hip) returns vs. Eagles, but his snaps may be managed
items.summary: Nacua has no injury designation after missing two games. Sean McVay said the team is still working out how much he will play, so the projection is trimmed 10%.

items.headline: Evans (ribs) a game-time decision vs. Broncos
items.summary: Evans missed practice Wednesday and Thursday and was limited Friday. He says he'll try to play through the rib injury. Check inactives about 90 minutes before kickoff.

items.headline: Panthers' leading receiver Coker (quad) questionable for SNF
items.summary: Coker missed the second half of Week 3. If he can't go, practice-squad WR Ja'seem Reed debuts, and Tetairoa McMillan leads a thin group with Xavier Legette also out.

items.headline: Allen added to the injury report with a groin injury before the London game
items.summary: Allen first appeared as a rest day, then the team listed a groin injury. The game kicks off at 9:30 a.m. ET, so check his status early.

items.headline: Bears won't name a starter between Keenum and Bagent vs. Jets
items.summary: Caleb Williams is out with a hamstring injury. Keenum threw for 247 yards and 3 TDs in last week's win, but Tyson Bagent is listed higher on the depth chart, and the projection follows the depth chart. Ben Johnson says, 'We'll find out on Sunday.'

items.headline: Jets rule out Hall, WR Adonai Mitchell and TE Mason Taylor vs. Bears
items.summary: Braelon Allen should lead the Jets backfield. Mitchell and Taylor being out thins out the receiving corps behind Garrett Wilson.

items.headline: Daniels (elbow) ruled out vs. Colts in London; Mariota starts again
items.summary: Daniels misses a second straight game with the dislocated left elbow, so Marcus Mariota makes another start. Mariota threw 3 TDs on 31 attempts last week. Washington hopes Daniels returns in Week 5 against the Giants.

items.headline: Okonkwo (hamstring) returns for Washington after missing two games
items.summary: Dan Quinn said Friday that Okonkwo is back after two missed games. He's still listed as questionable on the report, but expect him to play and take back the TE1 role from Ben Sinnott.

items.headline: Saints put Etienne (hamstring) on IR; out until at least Week 9
items.summary: Kellen Moore said Alvin Kamara and Kendre Miller will take most of Etienne's snaps, and CJ Donaldson will handle short yardage. His carries are redistributed in the projection.

items.headline: Kamara leads the Saints backfield with Etienne on IR
items.summary: Etienne had 13 carries in Week 3 before leaving the game, compared with 9 for Kamara and 4 for Miller. Kamara should get the first shot at lead-back work, but he has been inefficient (2.8 yards per carry), and Miller will take a real share.

items.headline: Dolphins plan a split backfield with Jaylen Wright while Achane is out
items.summary: Gordon had 20 touches in Week 3, but he was Miami's only other active back. Jeff Hafley expects to split the work with Jaylen Wright and ride the hot hand, so Gordon's Week 3 share probably overstates his role.

items.headline: Browns DT Mason Graham out for weeks with MCL and ankle sprains
items.summary: Cleveland's sack leader hurt his knee and ankle on TNF and is expected to miss several weeks. That weakens the Browns' run defense for the Oct. 11 game at the Jets.
